mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the triceps was most worthwhile because it completed the comparison: different attachments let the two muscles pull the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the triceps covering repeated the biceps construction, so it was predictable, though it reinforced that both use the same tissue.

surprise.text: The muscle bundles remained available after making the biceps, allowing the same kind of tissue to build the triceps too.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The coverings, tendons and empty back-muscle slot gave the combinations clear purposes.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the two pulls produce opposite movements was interesting, and I would be curious to see how the next body system fits together.
